items.title: NLTK incomplete fix: additional JVM/JAR sandbox bypass through unvalidated launcher tokens in java() command arguments
items.description:
Summary

NLTK 3.10.3 contains security hardening intended to close JVM argument-injection and untrusted JAR/classpath execution paths in nltk.internals.java(), including the issue published as GHSA-m4rf-3fr8-xwx3.

The patched options channel correctly rejects Java argument-file references such as @/path/to/args and launcher modes such as -jar. However, an additional argument channel remains: the caller-provided cmd sequence is appended to the Java command after the validated option and classpath channels, without enforcing that its first item is a Java main-class name.

I am reporting this as an additional post-fix bypass / incomplete-fix path affecting the 3.10.3 remediation, rather than as an unrelated vulnerability family.

items.title: NATS Server allows unauthenticated memory exhaustion through incomplete MQTT CONNECT packets
items.description:
Background

NATS.io is a high performance open source pub-sub distributed communication technology, built for the cloud, on-premise, IoT and edge computing.

The NATS Server supports MQTT clients, including authentication and parsing of MQTT CONNECT packets.

Problem Description

An unauthenticated MQTT client could cause the server to retain large incomplete MQTT CONNECT packets before authentication completed.

The parser retained partial pre-authentication packet data while waiting for the advertised MQTT packet length to be completed. An attacker could therefore consume server memory until authentication timeouts closed the connections.

Affected Versions

Versions v2.14.2, v2.12.11 and below are vulnerable. The issue is fixed in v2.14.3 and v2.12.12.

Workarounds

iocs.response_guidance: Block via DNS RPZ or Secure DNS. Search proxy logs. Submit to threat intel sharing platform.
iocs.detection_guidance: Monitor DNS query logs, proxy logs, and certificate transparency logs for domain resolution.

items.title: Mistune: Quadratic-time DoS in parse_link_href via unbounded parenthesis scan on empty-label links
items.description:
Resolution

Fixed in Mistune 3.3.4. Upgrade to 3.3.4 or later.

- Affected versions: < 3.3.4
- First patched version: 3.3.4
- Fix: https://github.com/lepture/mistune/compare/v3.3.3...v3.3.4

The reported payload was reproduced against the 3.3.3 release tag and verified to scale approximately linearly against the 3.3.4 release tag.

Original report

The following report describes the issue before the fix.

Summary
parse_link_href in mistune performs an unbounded parenthesis-balancing scan that runs to end-of-document on each unmatched (. Because the empty label [] bypasses the no_close_bracket_before high-water-mark guard, a single small document of the form "[](" * N causes O(N) openers to each drive an O(N) scan, producing O(N²) CPU on the default `mistune.h
